name: Kanojo ga Ossan ni Rachirarete ~ Choukyou Netorare Adventure!
original_name: 彼女がオッサンに拉致られて～調教寝取られアドベンチャー!
source:
His girlfriend was taken right before his eyes, on the day they were going to have sex for the first time...
But when he tries to rescue her, he gets captured, tied up, and forced to watch what unfolds...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ301082?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
